sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Maandhan Yojana (PMSMFY) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing social security to unorganized workers.
The scheme is designed to ensure a monthly pension for workers in the unorganized sector after they reach the age of 60.
The objective is to provide financial security and support to unorganized workers during their old age.
Eligible beneficiaries include unorganized workers aged between 18 to 40 years.
They must have a monthly income of less than Rs. 15,000.
The application process involves registering through the official portal or visiting designated centers.
Beneficiaries need to provide necessary documents such as identity proof and income proof during registration.
The pension amount is Rs. 3,000 per month after reaching the age of 60.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
The contributions to the pension fund are made by both the government and the beneficiaries.
The scheme aims to cover a significant number of unorganized workers across India.
